notes.title: 1.5.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed a bug where the special weapon energy indicator remained after pausing and quitting the game.

[*] Added a new special weapon 'Super Cooler' that slows the rate of increase in heat level when using rapidfire.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the game was occasionally slowing down, by compiling the build with YYC.

[*] You can now navigate menus and control player character with the joystick's hat switch.

[*] When setting your controls, pressing ESC disables the corresponding key.

[*] The difficulty of the 'Slothful' level has been slightly increased.

[*] When using a joystick with a dial, you can change the analog input to dial mode or disable it altogether in the Asteroid operation method.

[*] Added the option to activate rapidfire mode by pressing the fire key and the Devibomb key at the same time.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4 Patch Note
notes.content: You can now stop playing the game by entering the pause menu. If you stop the game, you can register the score you have achieved so far on the leaderboard.

notes.title: 1.35 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now a short invincibility period is triggered immediately after the shield item is destroyed.

[*] From now on, unregistered scores will not be visible on the Steam leaderboard screen.[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed Workers' A.I. so that they more aggressively attempt to steal crystals.

[*] Fixed bugs related to the "Successful Escape" achievement.[/list]

notes.title: 1.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where using a Stopper next to an item would cause an error.

[*] Fixed an issue where the player's name and score were duplicated with a certain probability when submitting a high score.[/list]

notes.title: 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue that caused the heartbeat sound effect to play at an abnormally high speed when Devileader were being completed.

[*] Fixed an issue where levels were not initialized when restarting after a game over.

[*] Fixed an issue where the first Devilleader encountered after using Hyper Warp Drive would be set to the lowest difficulty.

[*] The amount of bonus points you receive the first time you defeat the Devileader after using Hyper Warp Drive has been slightly reduced.

[*] Fixed an issue where the background music would continue playing if you defeated the Devileader right before you're eaten by it.[/list]

notes.title: 1.1 Patch Note
notes.content: You can now adjust the volume of the voice and background music in options.
